info.title: SYA Scheduler Function API
info.description: Scheduler FunctionHost contract and planner APIs. Draft previews never write the official plan. Commit is revision checked, durable and idempotent across restart; task and timeline reads can select a project or all projects.

post.summary: Preview fixed 25/45/90-minute presets or an independent custom target

level.description: Fixed presets or independent custom duration. fine/coarse are legacy aliases; omit targetMinutes for a fixed preset.

targetMinutes.description: Required for custom: integer 5–120. Presets are fixed at 25/45/90; a legacy preset request with a different explicit duration is treated as custom. The returned context.level identifies the normalized choice.

post.description: Choose one duration setting: finer (25), standard (45), coarser (90), or custom with targetMinutes (5–120). Custom reuses duration-based splitting and compatible adjacent-sibling merging; executed work and total estimates are preserved. For compatibility, legacy preset calls with a different explicit targetMinutes are normalized and persisted as custom.

taskIds.description: Every child ID of one parent, exactly once, in the desired order.

afterTaskId.description: Preceding task for a recovery interval; absent on work slots.

CalendarSlot.description: Real offset-aware calendar interval. Work slots have taskId; break/recovery slots have afterTaskId and never become executable tasks.

canCommit.description: False when the preview makes no change. A no-op commit returns NO_CHANGES; cancellation remains available.

date.description: Effective local date (YYYY-MM-DD). Earlier slots and executed work are preserved. Replaces later scheduled routine changes, disclosed in warnings.

focusflow.description: Shared work/meal minutes since midnight. hoursPerDay is the work window after meals, before cycle breaks. Explicit hours must match that availability.

focusMinutes.description: Default 45 when no cycle preference is saved. Strict integer.

breakMinutes.description: Default 5 when no cycle preference is saved. Strict integer.

recoveryMinutes.description: Default 15 when no cycle preference is saved. Strict integer.

cyclesBeforeRecovery.description: Default 4 when no cycle preference is saved. Strict integer.

availableMinutesPerDay.description: Nominal daily availability after meals, before cycle breaks.

routineCycleConfigured.description: False for legacy routines without an explicitly confirmed work/rest cycle.

preservedCount.description: Unchanged leaf count for granularity; protected executed leaf count for routine.

workMinutes.description: Work minutes across the complete proposed calendar, all projects and dates.

breakMinutes.description: Scheduled short and recovery minutes across the complete proposed calendar; excludes meals.

breaks.description: Short and recovery intervals, without taskId.
